content_html_sanitized:
Posted February 26, 2004
A personal commentary by Richard Cowan that will not be as off-topic as it seems.

As regular readers know, I try very hard to keep MarijuanaNews on-topic i.e. about cannabis and cannabis prohibition. And I like to say that this site is by me, but not about me.

However, I am going to make a bit of an exception here, but somehow it will end up back on-topic odd how that happens, so bear with me.

First, in this context, I must begin by confessing that I am a Christian, a Quaker by convincement. Jesus is the central figure and focus of my life. His teachings are the light by which I try to live, so the mocking title on this piece is not at all aimed at Jesus, but at the exploitation of his murder and the emotions of Christians.

(For those of you who are not fans of The Simpsons, Itchy and Scratchy is a recurring parody of cartoon violence in which an incredibly sadistic mouse brutally murders an incredibly stupid cat, with maximum gore. The point is that gore is not redemptive.)

Mel Gibson is undoubtedly sincere about his movie, The Passion of the Christ, as are the clergy that are urging their flocks to see it, but then so was the mob that shouted Crucify him! Sincerity is always necessary, but it is not sufficient.

Also, I should say upfront that there is no way that I am ever going to watch this movie, but I have read several reviews and I have seen some of the clips on television, looking away as quickly as possible.

However, inasmuch as all concerned are sincere Christians, let's deal with it at face value, and even grant their premise, as many Christians (myself included) do not, that the Bible is a precise and literal account of the events down to the tiniest detail.

The real obscenity is that this movie is getting maximum publicity in the country with the largest prison population in the world. People in agony even greater than crucifixion are denied easily available pain relief. In a rich land, the sick go without medicine. The poor go without food and shelter. Violence is our answer for everything. Why do Christians think that they have to go to a movie to see the suffering of Christ?

Finally, if you want to make a really controversial film about The Christ, show Him being anointed with the sacred Cannabosm. Show him using it to heal. Then the people who lined up to see Jesus tortured would be outraged and would scream Blasphemy just like the high priest who urged the crucifixion.
See
Religious Leaders Finally Beginning To Organize Opposition To The Drug War, A Mutiny for Mercy, But For Christians There May Be A More Compelling Reason Than They Realize.

And, like Pilate, they will leave the room without waiting to know the Truth. The Passion continues until we end it.
